objective.en: Map creek and street flooding across Atlanta under Hurricane Helene's clouds.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Observed rainfall, 24-28 Sep 2024 (Hurricane Helene rain in Atlanta). Flood cells are a heavy-rain PROXY, not mapped flood water: the wettest 30% of populated cells by IMERG event total (at least 177 mm). eventDay is the day a cell's cumulative IMERG rain first reached half its event total (mission day 0 = 2024-09-26; earlier lead-in rain counts as day 0).

sources.name: NASA SEDAC Gridded Population of the World v4, 2020 density (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Cells with at least 500 people per square kilometre count as populated neighbourhoods.

sources.name: NASA MODIS NRT Global Flood Product, 2-day composite (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Checked for observed flood water but no usable flood pixels were recorded. Checks: 2024-09-24 75% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2024-09-25 0% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2024-09-26 100% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2024-09-27 100% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2024-09-28 96% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2024-09-26 DSWx-S1 coverage 100%.

sources.name: Cloud cover and sensor detectability (educational model)
sources.usage: Not observed: per-cell cloud probability is a model (storm-cloud base, higher where IMERG rain was heavier) and detectability is a seeded model. The heavy-rain-to-flood rule is also a simplification.
